journey.name: Foreground Due No Banner
journey.description: A subscription payment that falls due while Bitkit is in the foreground opens the payment due sheet and posts no "Subscription Payment Due" banner for it; the banner is only for Bitkit in the background. Requires a payer wallet with an accepted monthly subscription and the payer's notification permission granted.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app on the payer with an accepted monthly subscription and notification permission granted
Open Dev Settings, set the subscription clock offset to 62 days, and return to Bitkit with it in the foreground
Verify the payment due sheet opens for the subscription
Wait five seconds and verify no "Subscription Payment Due" banner was posted, and none is listed for Bitkit in `adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact`
Dismiss the sheet and reset the subscription clock offset in Dev Settings
